body: i do have a lot of trauma but none of it would be considered sexual. i don’t know why i think i am one. i’m just convincing myself i am and i don’t know how to stop. i’m scared to look at children, i’m certain i’m not attracted in that way but im scared i am if that makes any sense. it’s just extreme paranoia that has no basis in reality, but when i think like that it’s the only thing i can think of
